description: Tenant themes must declare these tokens explicitly in :root and .dark. The bundle supplies :where() defaults, but some alias to a different semantic role than Registry / product intent — relying on the default silently mis-maps surfaces, selection fills, links, and focus.

notes.--card: Bundle default is var(--surface). Cards should map to page paper, not inset surface cream.
notes.--card-foreground: Bundle default is var(--foreground). Declare explicit ink alongside --card.
notes.--popover: Bundle default is var(--surface-raised). Flyouts should map to page paper / card surface, not raised surface.
notes.--popover-foreground: Bundle default is var(--foreground). Declare an explicit ink token alongside --popover.
notes.--accent-vivid: Bundle default is var(--brand-soft). Selected nav/sidebar fills need bright gold-300, not peach brand-soft.
notes.--accent-solid: Bundle default is var(--brand). Focus rings and solid chrome need gold-400, not dark brand-800.
notes.--accent-strong: Bundle default is var(--brand). Link text aliases accent-strong; needs gold-500, not brand-800.
notes.--ring: Bundle default is var(--brand). Keyboard focus on controls should use mid gold, not dark brand.
notes.--sidebar: Bundle default is var(--surface). Sidebar chrome should use neutral-100, not cream surface fill.
notes.--neutral-hover: Bundle default is var(--surface-raised). Muted-chrome hovers need neutral-100, not raised cream.
